# P34.24a — Sqitch lifecycle hygiene + round-trip CI (SIG-ENG-045)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-ENG-045** (migration lifecycle — this row owns
it) · **cited:** SIG-STORE-041 (sqitch-managed migrations), SIG-MEM-005
(clock-true records), SIG-MEM-007 (the `ci:` line), SIG-ENG-003 (ADR-196)
· **deferrals closed:** **D-P32.10a-1** (whole-plan `sqitch verify`
divided by zero — a stale `count(*) = 27` on the living
`spine_watermark` registry) and **D-P32.16a-1** (whole-plan
`sqitch revert` failed dropping image-owned `postgis`) — both closed
`OPEN → DONE` by appended `obligation-event/1` transitions citing this
PR's round-trip CI log · **Base:**
`r11/P34.23-versioning-discipline-one-version-source` (chain tip —
merge after it) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/228_P34.24a__sqitch-hygiene-and-round-trip-ci.md`
(manifest row 228 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Live stage:**
**none** — `live_verification=false`; no production mutations (OM-14);
not an OM-20 row.

## Why

The plan had never been deployed → verified → reverted → redeployed in
CI, so two defects hid behind deploy-only harnesses. The repair needed
a decision (a verify script for a deployed change cannot be edited in
place), an ownership model for extensions (the postgis image pre-installs
extensions the plan then "no-op creates" and later fails to drop), and
hygiene gaps: a mutable `sqitch/sqitch:latest` image in nine places, no
planner-identity guard, and no verify-lint against the stale-assertion
class.

## What this does

- **Append-only sqitch repair (D1):** `@r11-sqitch-hygiene` tag at the
  plan tip (L53), `sqitch rework shared_temporal_contract` appended at
  L54 — both stamped by sqitch with the clock and the recorded planner
  `Devin <devin@sig-project.org>`. The landed scripts are preserved
  byte-identical as `*@r11-sqitch-hygiene.sql` (fixture-compared in
  tests); the reworked deploy/revert are deliberate no-ops; the
  reworked verify asserts the **27 named facets** the change installs
  (publication_dispositions' 28th facet is asserted by *its* change, not
  a global count). **`db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 untouched — byte-identical
  to the C-10 fixture.**
- **Extension ownership (D2/ADR-196):** the plan owns only the
  extensions it creates. Every harness's plan database is now created
  `TEMPLATE template0` (`tests/db/conftest.py` shared helpers —
  `pg_container`, `create_plan_database`, `run_sqitch`, hardened
  `wait_ready` for the image's post-initdb restart), reused by
  `tests/e2e`, `tests/api`, `tests/resolution` and the composed
  scratch DB; deploys run with `--verify` so the whole-plan verify runs
  on every DB-suite pass.
- **Round-trip CI (D3):** `make test-sqitch-roundtrip` →
  `scripts/ci/sqitch_roundtrip.sh`: fresh `postgis/postgis:18-3.6` →
  `CREATE DATABASE sig TEMPLATE template0` → `deploy --verify` →
  `verify` → `revert -y` → clean-state asserts (extensions = `plpgsql`,
  zero non-sqitch relations, `sqitch.changes` empty) → redeploy →
  `verify`, logged to `docs/build/logs/sqitch-roundtrip-<UTC>.log`
  (gitignored; the CI step log is the durable cited evidence).
  **CI config changed (CI-8):** the `python` job gains the
  `Sqitch whole-plan round trip` step after `Test`; `make ci-local`
  runs the same target after the DB-suite run.
- **Guards (D4/D5/D6):** `tests/unit/test_sqitch_hygiene.py` — plan-tail
  structure, `@tag` byte-identity vs committed fixtures, no-op
  deploy/revert shape, named-facet verify, the verify-lint (any unscoped
  `count(*) FROM spine_watermark` in a live verify script fails;
  `@tag` preserved copies exempt), planner-identity on every post-L52
  line, and the image-pin guards (no mutable `sqitch/sqitch:<tag>` in
  operational paths; every digest equals the recorded pin). The P34.22a
  date guard's post-L52 `planned_at ≤ commit` rule now engages the two
  new lines.
- **Pinned image (D6):** `sqitch/sqitch@sha256:f247ab0e0b66e9c2d09a400864f7314358893f5cf209cddcc4f213f7d5bfe4d3`
  (the `latest` resolution at writing; App::Sqitch v1.6.1) in all
  conftests, `ops/docker-compose.yml`, `ops/gcp/materialize.sh`,
  `docs/build/tools/measure_watermark_p31.py`, `db/README.md`,
  `docs/build/reports/GCP_DEPLOYMENT.md`, and the round-trip script.
- **ADR-196** records the owned decisions (verify contract, extension
  ownership / one-plan-per-database, the rework mechanism, template0,
  the pinned image, C-10) with a revisit trigger; registered in the ADR
  index, spec Appendix F (spec rebuilt byte-identical),
  `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` and BL-084.

## Verification

- `make test-sqitch-roundtrip` — green locally
  (`docs/build/logs/sqitch-roundtrip-20261004T070815Z.log`): deploy
  --verify 54 changes → whole-plan verify ok → `revert -y` ok →
  extensions `plpgsql` only, 0 non-sqitch relations, `sqitch.changes` =
  0 → redeploy --verify ok → verify ok. The CI run on this PR's head is
  the cited evidence for the two deferral closures.
- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/db` — **498 passed**
  (template0 DB + `deploy --verify`; whole-plan verify runs inside the
  harness).
- `uv run pytest tests/unit` — green; the future-date sweep's only
  pre-commit findings were the two new plan lines' `planned_at` (by
  design — the bound is the commit that records them; green on this
  head).
- `make check` / `make docs-check` / `make ci-local` — verdicts in the
  run ledger's evidence log.

## What this does NOT do

No production contact: the hosted head read was **not executed** (no
verbatim operator go) and is not queued here — per the contract, P34.24b
reads the hosted head from its PITR-clone rehearsal. No `db/sqitch.plan`
line was edited or re-stamped (L44–52 byte-identical, asserted by test);
no landed deploy/revert/verify script edited (preserved as `*@tag`
copies); no historical obligation event or ADR rewritten; no merge/tag/
push of `main`; no human-gate ticks. The accepted limitation is recorded
in ADR-196: a whole-plan revert is only defined on a database the plan
owns — ops compose and hosted databases treat extensions as ambient
(`IF NOT EXISTS` deploy) and are deploy-only.
